actionAdapters.when: 活动目标为 Standalone 桌面平台或 WebGL，且已冻结精确输出路径与 Player 构建输入时；Android/iOS 不进入此 Action；当前Tool支持时，慢计划在同一operation=plan内用plan_mode=start/status/forget及Agent保留的request_id登记/读取/释放传输记录，不绕过原Core Plan/Execute/Verify。 服务端Tool缓存旧Schema时，只有Unity custom-tools已核实新字段且Provider提供现有execute_custom_tool，才以tool_name=nova_project_action/parameters=同一请求转交原Tool；单独客户端新会话不保证刷新，不改server配置或擅自重启。
用户指定已保存Batch，或构建授权覆盖发现/审查的同范围本地组合时；缺适用Batch先复用nova-project-configure-pipeline在当前Settings内创建或修正，保存及Verify后重新Plan本次run-batch。不存在Batch本身不永久blocked，不扩大平台/场景/输出或执行未授权远端Step。
用户要求本次WebGL本机HTTP/浏览器验收时，先inspect显式buildRoot并冻结contentHash，再serve绑定同摘要；仅loopback，不构建、不修改导出、不部署、不接管端口。

actionAdapters.entry: adb -s <frozenSerial> install -r <frozenApk>; adb -s <frozenSerial> shell dumpsys package <bundleId>; adb -s <frozenSerial> shell am start -W -n <resolvedComponent>
actionAdapters.when: 仅明确设备运行授权的Android APK安装分支；冻结本次artifact/hash/包/版本/签名与单设备、ABI/API、实际入口、同包替换影响；串行安装并读回，不默认降级/卸载/清数据。
仅明确设备运行授权的Android AAB分支；按platform-cli.md显式绑定签名与受保护password file，生成新APKS并检查提取APK签名，再指定同设备安装/读回；AAB签名不代表最终APK签名。
仅请求iOS原生编译或运行层时；按platform-cli.md从实际Xcode/SDK/工程/锁文件冻结唯一workspace或project、scheme、destination及签名策略。无签名iphoneos仅证明原生编译/链接，不证明可装设备；不用allowProvisioningUpdates/DeviceRegistration变更Apple外部状态。

actionAdapters.entry: DEVELOPER_DIR=<frozenXcode> xcrun devicectl list devices; xcrun devicectl device install app --device <frozenDeviceId> <frozenSignedApp>; xcrun devicectl device process launch --device <frozenDeviceId> <frozenBundleId>
actionAdapters.when: 仅明确iOS真机运行授权分支；本次已签名app/hash/Bundle ID、设备与替换影响冻结，按当前Xcode help指定设备安装/启动并读回。发现设备不算安装成功，不额外终止进程/注册设备/改Apple账号；业务与SDK设备证据分开。

actionAdapters.entry: DEVELOPER_DIR=<frozenXcode> xcrun simctl list devices; xcrun simctl install <frozenSimulatorUdid> <frozenSimulatorApp>; xcrun simctl launch <frozenSimulatorUdid> <frozenBundleId>
actionAdapters.when: 仅明确模拟器运行授权分支；实际iphonesimulator SDK产物/UDID/Bundle ID与当前help冻结，不能用iphoneos app安装模拟器。安装/启动需本次产物与真实业务观察，不等于真机或SDK效果。

inputs.name: projectRoot
inputs.constraint: 先从当前消费项目、持久化工作区和可用工具读取；展示来源后冻结，不要求新手重复填写可读取事实。已有授权持续有效，仍遵守当前Action的绑定计划确认。

inputs.name: enabledBuildScenes
inputs.constraint: 直接Player Action按其Plan冻结；Pipify入口由Agent在Batch外记录顺序、内容/脏态基线并前后复核，不视为BatchSnapshot已冻结。

inputs.name: platformOutputAndSigningOptions
inputs.constraint: 从当前PlayerSettings与已保存Batch读取有效平台选项；输出/签名有多个合理候选或缺实际权限时补充最少决策，不猜凭据。

inputs.name: executionEntry
inputs.constraint: 先从当前消费项目、持久化工作区和可用工具读取；展示来源后冻结，不要求新手重复填写可读取事实。已有授权持续有效，仍遵守当前Action的绑定计划确认。

inputs.name: requestedValidationLayers
inputs.constraint: 完整三平台或运行/存档验收时按references/platform-validation.md发现可执行层级，逐平台串行报告；普通单次Player构建不自动扩展。

inputs.name: platformRuntimeValidation
inputs.constraint: 仅用户要求运行层时，按platform-cli.md冻结当前宿主工具路径、APK/AAB/APKS或签名app身份、设备、实际入口、签名策略及时间窗；WebGL冻结buildRoot/contentHash/port与真实线程隔离要求。

inputs.name: deviceInstallScope
inputs.constraint: 仅设备安装/启动分支必需：绝对artifact路径及SHA-256、包标识/版本/证书摘要、精确serial/UDID、ABI/API、工具路径、实际入口、时间窗、已有同包版本/签名与保留数据的替换影响。普通Player构建不要求设备；artifact/设备/签名/影响漂移后重新绑定计划。

allow: confirmed local Player output path or platform project directory
documented build-processor staging, markers and generated platform files
temporary Build Settings, Android output and signing values restored by existing adapters
authorized same-scope local Batch preparation in current PipifySettingsSO through nova-project-configure-pipeline before a new run plan
only requested device-install branch: frozen device and application install/update/launch while preserving existing user data
only requested AAB-install branch: new local APKS and authorized protected signing input files, cleaned after acceptance

three exact audited official postbuild scalar resets: freeze actual Generated/HasWarned/scenesProcessed before execution; accept observed zero after the normal callback chain only, never pre-set or restore vendor counters
TMP exact approved asset Load/official clear native-memory effects and Facebook official binding to the unique existing Resources asset only; source files preserved and typed before/after required

exact audited normal Core usage, SRP empty-list pool, Adaptive empty metadata initialization/comparison and WebGL BuildEvents cache effects; unchanged Analytics settings, typed actual before/after/report, no provider prewarm, payload clearing, replay or delivery claim
deny: unrelated source, Scene, Prefab or generated output
CDN, store upload and any remote release write
Git commit or push and UPM publish
unrequested device installation, arbitrary device selection, implicit downgrade/uninstall/clear-data/grant-all-permissions
reusing or deleting pre-existing APKS without exact overwrite authorization, or exposing signing passwords in command/log output

locks: device-install branch only: frozen device serial/UDID plus application; no device lock in build-only branch

requiredFor: 覆盖已有 Player 或平台工程输出
Android DevelopmentBuild 与 AAB 组合
读取或临时应用签名凭据
delete, external write, Git commit or push
device-install branch: exact artifact/device/signing or replacement-impact change; existing explicit runtime authorization covers frozen install/launch
confirmation.rule: 确认绑定 Target、Scene 闭包、输出路径、BuildMode、DevelopmentBuild、DevelopMode 和平台专属选项；任一输入改变后旧确认失效。 已有完整构建授权可覆盖审查后的必要本地组合；可读取参数由Agent发现并展示，缺业务选择或真实外部权限才补充输入。Batch外Scene、Master、Runtime、PlayerSettings与动态参数基线独立记录，不能称当前Batch Plan完整冻结。 明确运行授权覆盖精确设备安装/启动与本机HTTP验收；降级、卸载、清数据、设备注册、Apple账号变更和外部发布不随构建默认授权。

evidence: 冻结的 Target、Build Settings Scene、输出路径与两类构建模式
本次本地 Player 或平台工程产物
临时 Build Settings、YooAsset staging 与签名值的恢复结果
未执行真机、商店、CDN、Git 与 UPM 发布的边界说明
现存Batch发现与有序依赖审查；本次适用生成代码在热更DLL前完成的证据
Batch外Scene/Master/Runtime/PlayerSettings基线、多平台/Batch组合时每平台切换稳定、前后漂移与显式preflight结果；Job成功不代替产物
按请求分层的Android运行、iOS工程/Pods/原生编译/签名设备、WebGL HTTP/首包/浏览器及独立生命周期存档；未做层级保留partial
本轮临时文件、测试key与设置恢复/清场结果，及要求保留的正式产物
随包WebGL inspect冻结摘要、真实HTTP压缩/MIME响应及浏览器消费；Android签名/包身份与精确设备readback、AAB→APKS工具/签名证据、iOS原生/签名/设备逐层证据；工具help不是运行验证。

device-install branch only: artifact SHA-256 and signing/package compatibility, explicit device/entry, install completion plus package/version/certificate readback and real business probes; Inspector process-start boolean and tool help do not prove installation. Build-only branch retains player-build evidence without device requirement.
慢计划使用传输子模式时：同request_id登记与完整原响应取回，原ready/blocked状态、过期/域重载边界与精确forget清场；收件completed或plan_candidate不等于Player构建证据。

Player schema4 Receipt binds actual typed normal-reset before/after, callback-chain return and current zero postcondition with exact field/module identities; old or incomplete receipts remain partial. Exact Firebase Xcode logger and paired SRP DLL/MVID identities retain all other input gates.

TMP exact before/after/error, natural existing-asset Load lifecycle and narrow official clear, persistent font/source/atlas identity and complete file/meta/pixel/cache/event invariants; 26 pure tests and an Inconclusive integration probe do not prove a Player build.

Facebook official null-to-unique-existing-Resources binding with exact singleton/asset ownership, full config hashes, original dirty state, candidate closure and callback identities; no getter prewarm, creation, login, business SDK or network invocation.

Core usage / WebGL BuildEvents / SRP-null-global / Adaptive-empty-metadata typed actual before/after/report; source identity, unchanged original objects/settings and all declared native usage effects. Independent Player requires the own StripAOT guard lease to be naturally inactive.
